metadata.serialization: UTF-8 JSON.stringify of selected metadata, no final newline

provenance.originArchiveVerification: Committed origin pins retained; original archives are not reread by each harness run.

bson.resolution: backend require(mongodb) -> MongoDB require(bson); mongodb.BSON export identity verified
bson.phase: setup before either count or timing capture
bson.scope: Serialized validator input documents; excludes database commands, wire framing, compression, indexes and before images. Unspecified library options retain the pinned installed defaults.

negatives.name: matching receipt around broken floor link

measured.nativeEncodingCounter: No native call count inferred from JS wrappers or absent named entries.
measured.missingCounterConvention: Missing entries remain absent. Known zero-call windows may omit a function; unknown absence is never coerced to zero.

limitations: Engineering empty-row metadata at fixed checkpoint/replay-receipt count; no full recovery, consensus or busy-chain qualification.
Counts and timing are separate modes and processes. Precise coverage changes optimization behavior; count captures are not timing observations.
Timing includes observation overhead and heap/order history; forward/reverse passes are not independent repetitions or quantified profiler overhead.
No optimization, cache, runtime ranking or performance benefit is selected by this harness.
